parse_obs: parse a Meta-World observation vector into hand position, peg position, and goal position fields
desired_pos: compute the desired end-effector position for the peg insertion task based on current state
grab_effort: compute the gripper grab effort value based on the robot hand and peg proximity
review_policy: review the SawyerPegInsertionSideV2Policy class and its peg insertion decision logic
